meta.title: Gone fishing, for bicycles: the strange catch of Amsterdam's canals
meta.deck: Every year a small crane boat hauls thousands of bikes out of the city's waterways.
meta.note: 这是一篇仿《经济学人》风格的原创练习文章，不是真实外刊的转载。文中的事实是概括性描述，仅供语言学习，请不要当作引用来源。

sents.en: Gone fishing, for bicycles: the strange catch of Amsterdam's canals
sents.zh: 去钓鱼，钓自行车：阿姆斯特丹运河里的奇特“渔获”
notes: Gone fishing：店门口常挂的“钓鱼去了”，这里接 for bicycles 制造反差。
catch：名词，捕获物、渔获。

sents.en: Every year a small crane boat hauls thousands of bikes out of the city's waterways.
sents.zh: 每年，一艘带起重机的小船都会从城里的水道中捞出成千上万辆自行车。
notes: crane boat：带吊臂的船。
haul A out of B：从 B 里把 A 拖 / 拉出来。
waterway：水道、航道。

sents.en: The catch says a lot about a country where bicycles outnumber people.
sents.zh: 这些“渔获”很能说明一个自行车比人还多的国家是什么样子。
notes: say a lot about：很能说明……（之前学过 say less about）。
outnumber：在数量上超过。

sents.en: On a grey weekday morning, a flat boat glides along a canal in central Amsterdam, its crane arm dipping into the murky water.
sents.zh: 一个阴沉的工作日早晨，一艘平底船沿着阿姆斯特丹市中心的运河缓缓滑行，吊臂不时探进浑浊的水里。
notes: glide：平稳地滑行。
its crane arm dipping ...：独立主格结构，描写吊臂的动作。
murky：浑浊的、看不清的。

sents.en: Moments later it surfaces with a dripping tangle of metal: handlebars, wheels and a bike lock still firmly fastened.
sents.zh: 片刻之后，吊臂提上来一团湿淋淋、缠在一起的金属：车把、车轮，还有一把仍然锁得牢牢的车锁。
notes: surface：浮出水面，这里作动词。
a dripping tangle of metal：一团滴着水、缠在一起的金属。
still firmly fastened：仍然牢牢地锁着，过去分词作后置修饰。

sents.en: The crew pile the wreckage onto the deck and move on to the next spot.
sents.zh: 船员们把这些残骸堆到甲板上，接着开往下一个地点。
notes: crew 作主语时英式常用复数动词 pile。
pile A onto B：把 A 堆到 B 上。
move on to：继续进行到（下一个）。

sents.en: By some estimates, they pull out between 12,000 and 15,000 bicycles a year.
sents.zh: 据一些估计，他们每年要捞出一万两千到一万五千辆自行车。
notes: By some estimates：据某些估计（之前学过）。
pull out：拉出、捞出。

sents.en: How so many bikes end up in the water is a matter of some debate.
sents.zh: 这么多自行车是怎么跑到水里去的，至今还有些争议。
notes: How ... in the water：how 引导主语从句。
end up：最终落得、最后到了。
a matter of debate：有争议的问题。

sents.en: Some are stolen, ridden around and then dumped; others are pushed in by pranksters after a night out.
sents.zh: 有些是被偷了、骑了一圈然后扔掉的；还有些是被晚上出去玩的恶作剧者推下去的。
notes: stolen, ridden around and then dumped：三个过去分词表示先后发生的动作。
dump：随意丢弃。
a night out：晚上出去玩（喝酒、聚会）。

sents.en: A few slip in by accident when they are parked too close to the edge, and some owners, tired of an old wreck, simply leave theirs to the water.
sents.zh: 有少数是停得离岸边太近，不小心滑下去的；还有些车主嫌旧车破，干脆把它交给了河水。
notes: slip in：滑进去。by accident：意外地。
tired of ...：对……厌烦，插在主语和谓语之间。
an old wreck：一辆破车。leave theirs to the water：把自己的车留给河水。

sents.en: Locals joke that there are three layers at the bottom of each canal: mud, bikes and then more mud.
sents.zh: 当地人开玩笑说，每条运河底部都有三层：泥、自行车，然后还是泥。
notes: joke that ...：开玩笑说。
layer：层。冒号后列举三层。

sents.en: The scale of cycling in the Netherlands helps explain the problem.
sents.zh: 荷兰骑车人数的规模，有助于解释这个问题。
notes: scale：规模。
help (to) explain：有助于解释，help 后可直接接动词原形。

sents.en: The country has an estimated 23 million bicycles for 18 million people, and in cities many residents own two: a good one for long rides and a battered one for leaving at the station.
sents.zh: 这个国家估计有 2300 万辆自行车，而人口只有 1800 万；在城市里，很多居民有两辆：一辆好车骑远路，一辆破车停在车站。
notes: an estimated 23 million：估计有两千三百万。
own two：拥有两辆，冒号后解释。
battered：破旧的、被用得很狠的。

sents.en: The second kind is rarely locked with much care, which is precisely what makes it a target.
sents.zh: 第二种车很少被认真锁好，而这恰恰让它成了目标。
notes: with much care：小心地，rarely 让整句变成否定。
which 指前面整件事。precisely：恰恰、正是。
a target：目标（被偷、被推下水）。

sents.en: Parking is a constant headache.
sents.zh: 停车一直是个让人头疼的问题。
notes: a headache：比喻“令人头疼的事”。constant：一直存在的。

sents.en: Utrecht's main station now has a multi-storey garage with room for 12,500 bikes, reputedly the largest in the world, and it still fills up on busy days.
sents.zh: 乌得勒支中央车站如今有一座多层自行车库，可停放 12,500 辆车，据说是世界最大的，可在忙碌的日子里还是会停满。
notes: multi-storey：多层的（英式；美式 multi-story）。
with room for：能容纳……。
reputedly：据说、普遍认为。

sents.en: Little of what comes out of the water is thrown away.
sents.zh: 从水里捞出来的东西，几乎都不会被扔掉。
notes: Little of ...：……几乎没有，否定意味。
what comes out of the water：what 从句。

sents.en: The bikes are taken to a depot, where the few that are registered can be traced back to their owners.
sents.zh: 自行车被运到一个仓库，其中少数登记过的可以追查到车主。
notes: depot：仓库、车库。where 引导定语从句。
the few that are registered：少数登记过的。
trace back to：追溯到、追查到。

sents.en: The rest are scrapped and the metal is recycled, sometimes ending up in new bicycles.
sents.zh: 其余的被当作废品处理，金属回收再利用，有时最后又变成了新的自行车。
notes: scrap：当作废品处理、报废。
recycle：回收利用。
ending up in ...：最后变成……，伴随结果。

sents.en: Seen this way, the canal fishermen are not so much cleaning up a mess as closing a loop.
sents.zh: 这样看来，这些运河“渔夫”与其说是在收拾烂摊子，不如说是在让资源循环起来。
notes: Seen this way：这样看来，过去分词短语作状语。
not so much A as B：与其说是 A，不如说是 B。
close a loop：形成闭环。

sents.en: Visitors often stop to film the crane at work, delighted by such an odd spectacle.
sents.zh: 游客常常停下来拍吊臂干活，被这种奇特的景象逗乐了。
notes: stop to film：停下来去拍，注意区分 stop filming（停止拍摄）。
delighted by：因……而高兴。
spectacle：景象、奇观。

sents.en: For residents it is merely routine, as unremarkable as rubbish collection.
sents.zh: 对居民来说，这只是例行公事，就像收垃圾一样稀松平常。
notes: routine：例行公事、日常程序。
as unremarkable as ...：和……一样平常。

sents.en: Yet the sight of a bicycle rising from a canal says something about the Dutch: practical, unsentimental and quietly amused by their own habits.
sents.zh: 可一辆自行车从运河里升起来的画面，也透露出荷兰人的一些特点：务实、不感情用事，对自己的习惯还暗暗觉得好笑。
notes: the sight of ...：……的景象。
says something about：说明了……的一些东西。
冒号后三个形容词描述荷兰人。

sents.en: In a city built on water and wheels, it was only a matter of time before the two met.
sents.zh: 在一座建在水与车轮之上的城市里，两者相遇只是时间问题。
notes: built on water and wheels：建在水和车轮之上，比喻城市的两大特色。
it was only a matter of time before ...：……只是时间问题。

vocab.zh: 捕获物、渔获；隐藏的问题
vocab.note: a good catch（收获颇丰）。口语 What's the catch?（有什么猫腻？）之前学过 there is a catch（其中有诈）。

ex.en: The fishermen brought home a big [[catch]].
ex.zh: 渔民们满载而归。

ex.en: Today's [[catch]] includes two old bikes and a chair.
ex.zh: 今天的“渔获”有两辆旧自行车和一把椅子。

vocab.note: haul sth out of / up：把重物拖出来、拉上来。名词 haul 也指“一大批（收获）”：a big haul of shopping。

ex.en: They [[hauled]] the boat onto the beach.
ex.zh: 他们把船拖上了沙滩。

ex.en: Firefighters [[hauled]] the car out of the river.
ex.zh: 消防员把车从河里拖了出来。

vocab.note: 运河、河流等可以行船的水路。inland waterways（内陆水道）。

ex.en: The city is crossed by narrow [[waterways]].
ex.zh: 城市里纵横交错着狭窄的水道。

ex.en: Boats are the best way to see the [[waterways]].
ex.zh: 坐船是游览水道的最好方式。

vocab.note: A outnumber B：A 比 B 多。Women outnumber men in this class.（这个班女生比男生多。）

ex.en: Tourists [[outnumber]] locals in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天游客比本地人还多。

ex.en: We were [[outnumbered]] three to one.
ex.zh: 对方人数是我们的三倍。

vocab.note: 平稳、安静地移动：a swan glides across the lake（天鹅滑过湖面）。

ex.en: The skater [[glided]] across the ice.
ex.zh: 滑冰的人在冰上滑过。

ex.en: A plane [[glides]] down to the runway.
ex.zh: 飞机滑翔着降向跑道。

vocab.note: dip A into B：把 A 浸到 B 里。dip a biscuit in tea（把饼干蘸茶）。也指“下降”：Prices dipped.

ex.en: She [[dipped]] her toes in the water.
ex.zh: 她把脚趾探进水里。

ex.en: [[Dip]] the bread in the soup.
ex.zh: 把面包蘸到汤里。

vocab.note: murky water（浑水）。比喻：a murky past（不光彩、说不清的过去）。

ex.en: The river was too [[murky]] to see the bottom.
ex.zh: 河水太浑，看不见底。

ex.en: The details of the deal remain [[murky]].
ex.zh: 这笔交易的细节仍然不清不楚。

vocab.note: a tangle of wires / hair（一团乱线 / 乱发）。形容词 tangled（缠在一起的）。

ex.en: There was a [[tangle]] of cables behind the TV.
ex.zh: 电视后面是一团乱糟糟的电线。

ex.en: My headphones are always [[tangled]].
ex.zh: 我的耳机线总是缠在一起。

vocab.note: drip（滴水）。dripping wet（湿透的）。a dripping tap（滴水的龙头）。

ex.en: He came in from the rain, [[dripping]] wet.
ex.zh: 他从雨里进来，浑身湿透。

ex.en: Fix that [[dripping]] tap, please.
ex.zh: 请把那个滴水的龙头修一下。

vocab.note: fasten your seat belt（系好安全带）。t 不发音：/ˈfɑːsən/。

ex.en: Please [[fasten]] your seat belt.
ex.zh: 请系好安全带。

ex.en: The gate was [[fastened]] with a chain.
ex.zh: 大门用铁链锁着。

vocab.note: 不可数。车祸、空难、船难之后的残骸。wreck（残骸、破旧的东西）是可数名词。

ex.en: Rescuers searched the [[wreckage]].
ex.zh: 救援人员在残骸中搜寻。

ex.en: [[Wreckage]] from the boat washed up on the beach.
ex.zh: 船的残骸被冲上了海滩。

vocab.note: pile up（堆积）。名词 a pile of books（一堆书）。

ex.en: Dirty dishes [[piled]] up in the sink.
ex.zh: 脏碗碟堆满了水槽。

ex.en: She [[piled]] the books on the table.
ex.zh: 她把书堆在桌上。

vocab.zh: 继续前进；转到（下一件事）
vocab.note: move on to the next question（进入下一个问题）。也可以比喻“放下过去”：It's time to move on.

ex.en: Let's [[move on]] to the next topic.
ex.zh: 我们进入下一个话题吧。

ex.en: After the break-up, she found it hard to [[move on]].
ex.zh: 分手后，她很难走出来。

vocab.zh: 最终（到某处、处于某种状态）
vocab.note: end up + 地点 / doing / 形容词：We ended up eating at home.（我们最后在家吃了。）

ex.en: We got lost and [[ended up]] in the wrong town.
ex.zh: 我们迷了路，最后到了另一个镇。

ex.en: If you don't save, you'll [[end up]] broke.
ex.zh: 你不存钱，最后会身无分文。

vocab.note: a matter of + 名词：……的问题。a matter of taste（口味问题）、a matter of time（时间问题）。

ex.en: Who invented it first is [[a matter of debate]].
ex.zh: 谁先发明的还有争议。

ex.en: Its real age is [[a matter of some debate]].
ex.zh: 它真正的年代还有一些争议。

vocab.zh: 倾倒、随意丢弃；甩掉（恋人）
vocab.note: dump rubbish（乱倒垃圾）。口语 dump sb（甩了某人）。名词 a dump（垃圾场；脏乱的地方）。

ex.en: Someone [[dumped]] an old sofa by the road.
ex.zh: 有人把一张旧沙发扔在路边。

ex.en: He was [[dumped]] by text message.
ex.zh: 他是被短信分手的。

vocab.note: prank（恶作剧）+ -ster。play a prank on sb：捉弄某人。

ex.en: A [[prankster]] put a traffic cone on the statue.
ex.zh: 一个恶作剧的人把路锥扣在了雕像头上。

ex.en: The kids played a [[prank]] on their teacher.
ex.zh: 孩子们捉弄了他们的老师。

vocab.zh: 晚上出去玩（吃饭、喝酒、聚会）
vocab.note: have a night out with friends（和朋友出去玩一晚）。反义 a night in（在家过夜）。

ex.en: We had [[a night out]] for her birthday.
ex.zh: 我们为她过生日出去玩了一晚。

ex.en: After [[a night out]], he slept until noon.
ex.zh: 晚上出去玩了以后，他一觉睡到中午。

vocab.zh: 残骸；破旧不堪的东西（或人）
vocab.note: 可数：an old wreck（一辆破车）。口语形容人：I'm a wreck today.（我今天累垮了。）动词 wreck：毁坏。

ex.en: His first car was an old [[wreck]].
ex.zh: 他的第一辆车是辆破车。

ex.en: The storm [[wrecked]] the garden.
ex.zh: 暴风雨毁了花园。

vocab.note: a layer of dust（一层灰），wear layers（穿多层衣服）。

ex.en: The table was covered in a thick [[layer]] of dust.
ex.zh: 桌子上落了厚厚一层灰。

ex.en: Wear [[layers]] when you go hiking.
ex.zh: 去徒步要穿得一层一层的。

vocab.note: on a large scale（大规模地），the scale of the problem（问题的严重程度）。地图上的比例尺也叫 scale。

ex.en: Nobody expected the [[scale]] of the damage.
ex.zh: 没人料到破坏的程度这么大。

ex.en: The festival is held on a huge [[scale]].
ex.zh: 这个节日规模盛大。

vocab.note: batter（连续猛击）的过去分词作形容词：a battered old suitcase（一个破旧的老箱子）。

ex.en: He still drives a [[battered]] old van.
ex.zh: 他还开着一辆破旧的面包车。

ex.en: She carries a [[battered]] notebook everywhere.
ex.zh: 她走到哪儿都带着一本破旧的笔记本。

vocab.note: That's precisely the point.（这正是问题所在。）也表示“准确地”：at precisely 9 o'clock（九点整）。

ex.en: That is [[precisely]] why I called you.
ex.zh: 这正是我给你打电话的原因。

ex.en: The train left at [[precisely]] six.
ex.zh: 火车六点整准时开出。

vocab.note: an easy target（容易得手的目标），hit a target（达到目标）。动词：target young people（针对年轻人）。

ex.en: Tourists are an easy [[target]] for pickpockets.
ex.zh: 游客很容易成为小偷的目标。

ex.en: We hit our sales [[target]] this month.
ex.zh: 这个月我们达到了销售目标。

vocab.note: 本义“头疼”：I have a headache. 比喻：Traffic is a real headache.（交通真让人头疼。）

ex.en: Finding a babysitter is always a [[headache]].
ex.zh: 找保姆总是件头疼的事。

ex.en: I woke up with a terrible [[headache]].
ex.zh: 我醒来时头疼得厉害。

vocab.note: 英式拼法，storey = 楼层。a multi-storey car park（多层停车场）。美式写 multi-story。

ex.en: We parked in a [[multi-storey]] car park.
ex.zh: 我们把车停在了一个多层停车场。

ex.en: The old [[multi-storey]] building was pulled down.
ex.zh: 那栋老旧的多层楼被拆了。

vocab.note: reputation（名声）相关。The house is reputedly haunted.（据说这房子闹鬼。）比学过的 reportedly（据报道）更偏“传闻、名声”。

ex.en: The restaurant [[reputedly]] serves the best pasta in town.
ex.zh: 据说这家餐厅的意面是全城最好吃的。

ex.en: He is [[reputedly]] the richest man in the village.
ex.zh: 据说他是村里最有钱的人。

vocab.note: bus depot（公交总站）。注意发音：英式 /ˈdepəʊ/，t 不发音。

ex.en: The buses return to the [[depot]] at night.
ex.zh: 公交车晚上开回总站。

ex.en: Lost bikes are kept at a [[depot]] near the port.
ex.zh: 丢失的自行车存放在港口附近的一个仓库里。

vocab.note: trace sth back to sb / sth：追查到……。The problem was traced back to a faulty cable.（问题追查到一根坏电线。）

ex.en: The fire was [[traced back to]] a candle.
ex.zh: 火灾追查到是一支蜡烛引起的。

ex.en: Her family can be [[traced back to]] the 1600s.
ex.zh: 她的家族可以追溯到 17 世纪。

vocab.note: scrap an old car（报废旧车）。也指取消计划：The plan was scrapped.（计划取消了。）名词 scrap metal（废金属）。

ex.en: The old trains will be [[scrapped]].
ex.zh: 旧火车将被报废。

ex.en: They [[scrapped]] the idea after one meeting.
ex.zh: 开了一次会，他们就放弃了这个主意。

vocab.note: recycle paper / plastic / glass。名词 recycling（回收）。

ex.en: We [[recycle]] all our bottles.
ex.zh: 我们的瓶子全部回收利用。

ex.en: This bag is made of [[recycled]] plastic.
ex.zh: 这个袋子是用回收塑料做的。

vocab.expr: not so much A as B
vocab.zh: 与其说是 A，不如说是 B
vocab.note: 否定 A 的说法，强调 B 才更准确：He is not so much shy as quiet.（与其说他害羞，不如说他安静。）A 和 B 词性要对等。

ex.en: It's [[not so much]] a job as a hobby.
ex.zh: 与其说这是工作，不如说是爱好。

ex.en: She was [[not so much]] angry as disappointed.
ex.zh: 与其说她生气，不如说她失望。

vocab.conn: not so much + A + as + B（A、B 结构相同）
vocab.say: not so much cleaning up a mess as closing a loop

pick.q: The problem is not so much the money ___ the time.
pick.why: 固定搭配 not so much A as B，后面用 as，不用 than。

pick.q: He didn't so much walk ___ run out of the room.
pick.why: not so much ... as ... 也可以把 not 放在助动词上：didn't so much walk as run（与其说是走，不如说是跑）。

vocab.note: 比 happy 程度深：I'm delighted to meet you. be delighted by / with / at：因……而高兴。

ex.en: I'd be [[delighted]] to help.
ex.zh: 我非常乐意帮忙。

ex.en: The children were [[delighted]] with the puppy.
ex.zh: 孩子们看到小狗高兴坏了。

vocab.zh: 景象、奇观；（引人注目的）场面
vocab.note: 注意和学过的形容词 spectacular（壮观的）区分。make a spectacle of oneself：当众出丑。

ex.en: The fireworks were a wonderful [[spectacle]].
ex.zh: 烟花真是壮观的景象。

ex.en: The fight in the street became a public [[spectacle]].
ex.zh: 街头斗殴成了众人围观的场面。

vocab.note: 名词：my morning routine（我每天早上的固定流程）。形容词：a routine check（例行检查）。

ex.en: Exercise is part of my daily [[routine]].
ex.zh: 锻炼是我每天的固定安排。

ex.en: It was just a [[routine]] check.
ex.zh: 那只是一次例行检查。

vocab.note: un-（不）+ remarkable（值得注意的、了不起的）。

ex.en: The town itself is fairly [[unremarkable]].
ex.zh: 这个小镇本身相当平淡无奇。

ex.en: He had an [[unremarkable]] childhood.
ex.zh: 他的童年平平无奇。

vocab.note: sentimental（多愁善感的、感情用事的）的反义。an unsentimental view of life（对人生务实的看法）。

ex.en: She is [[unsentimental]] about throwing old things away.
ex.zh: 扔旧东西的时候她一点也不感情用事。

ex.en: The film gives an [[unsentimental]] picture of war.
ex.zh: 这部电影冷静地展现了战争。

vocab.note: It's only a matter of time before ...：……只是迟早的事。

ex.en: It's only [[a matter of time]] before he finds out.
ex.zh: 他发现只是迟早的事。

ex.en: Success is [[a matter of time]].
ex.zh: 成功只是时间问题。

cloze.hint: 有争议的问题（a matter of some ___）

breakdown.en: The country has an estimated 23 million bicycles for 18 million people, and in cities many residents own two: a good one for long rides and a battered one for leaving at the station.
points: 前半句：The country has an estimated 23 million bicycles for 18 million people —— 1800 万人拥有约 2300 万辆车，for 表示“对应、相对于”。
and 连接后半句：in cities many residents own two —— 城里很多人有两辆。
冒号后解释哪两辆：a good one for long rides（好车骑远路）和 a battered one for leaving at the station（破车停车站）。one 代替 bicycle。
for leaving at the station：for + 动名词，说明用途。
